name: North-west back-of-house wedge (Market/Seafood/Bakery production + receiving; staff only). 211 m2 of floor with ZERO fixtures and zero product labels drawn in it, fenced off from the sales floor by one continuous 0.575-pt wall stroke traced here vertex for vertex: (374.4,120.1)-(375,132.8)-(338.8,133.1)-(327.9,164)-[door recess to (315.9,160.6)/(313.1,173.3)]-(323.3,176.4)-(294.8,253.5)-[staff door, the 5-pt break to (296.4,258.4) with its leaf drawn at (287.4,259.3)-(291.7,251.9)]-(296.7,296.2)-[second door recess to (286.5,296.2)/(286.8,305.4)]-(296.1,387.4)-(284.3,386.8)-(285.2,399.2)-(262,398.3)-(261.1,401.7); north/west it is the building outline (277.5,120.3)-(241.9,214.6)-(239.6,242.2)-(210.8,244.5)-(210.8,394), south the drawn diagonal (211.6,393.8)-(237.8,404.2) and the Floral cases [237.3,403.7,266,415.3]/[266.3,405.1,293.8,418] whose display scallops are drawn on their SOUTH face, so Floral is shopped from the sales floor below them. The FLORAL title (256.5,387) is printed inside this blank block (same as 269's SEAFOOD/BAKERY titles), which is why an auto disk was needed to seal it at all; the leak was the staff door at x=294.8-296.4 / y=253.5-258.4, and that leak is what merged 78 m2 of Bakery customer floor into the same culled pocket (see inclusions.json). The two door recesses are wall-thickness floor at a back-door opening and are sealed with the block, as on 388. Nothing here is drawn as shopping floor: the Bakery's own display tables ([315.7,261.3,350.5,270.2] and the four below it) all stand EAST of the x=296 wall

Pharmacy room (staff/dispensary; no customer entrance is drawn). A 90 m2 alcove in the south-east corner holding NOTHING — no fixture, no counter, no product label, only the red 'Pharmacy' title (1138-1169, 511-628) printed inside it. It is walled on every side: west/north-west the 1.15-pt wall stroke (1164.5,450.3)-(1164.5,457.3)-curve-(1163.4,488.9)-(1138.2,543)-(1133.2,543.3)-(1102.5,573.4)-(1116.9,588.4) continued by the wall-thickness rect [1109.8,588.4,1116.9,634.6]; north the wall-shelf rect [1164.5,187.4,1179.8,450.3] that plugs the 16-pt slot against the east wall; south the wall (1153,639.45)-(1106.2,639.45) and the building outline (1153.8,640.1)-(1179.1,640.1); east the building outline itself. It read 100% walkable only because the raster leaks through two sub-cell breaks in that drawn wall: the BFS route in reaches it by crossing the curve at (1155-1159,495), and a second 3.6x1.5-pt hole sits where the wall rect's corner (1109.8,634.6) fails to meet the wall jog (1103.6,635.8)-(1106.2,639.45). Both are draughting gaps, not doorways — every real opening on this map is drawn 20 pt or wider with jambs. Consistent with 790 ('the pharmacy room itself stays sealed'), 659 and 265, where only a DRAWN waiting recess in front of a DRAWN counter is customer space; this guide draws neither, so no part of the alcove can be defended as shopping floor. Consequence to expect: the PHARMACY anchor now snaps ~5 m west to its nearest customer floor, the same way 269's DAIRY title snaps forward off its back block
